# simoneheijloo.nl source guide

## Luna quick start · checked 18 October 2026

- Open the official [African Contemporary – De Hallen page](https://simoneheijloo.nl/african-contemporary/).
- Read the current **Dates & Fee** block near the top for the October–November 2026 dates; a separate June block appears lower down and has old prices.
- Copy each explicitly listed date, class time, single-class price, series price, venue, audience, and signup method. Keep €20 as the single-class price shown in the October–November block; do not copy the old June rate.
- Stop when the page shows no new dated block in `{start_date}`–`{end_date}`. Do not create dates from the Monday recurrence or enter the booking flow.

Copyable prompt: `On https://simoneheijloo.nl/african-contemporary/, read the current dated schedule for {start_date} to {end_date}. Return exact listed dates, time, single-class and series price, venue, audience, and signup method. Ignore the older June block and leave missing fields unstated. Stop if there is no dated block in range; do not expand Mondays or book.`

Saved evidence checked through 2026-10-18.

## Recheck rules

- Use public, actual date-selectable pages for dated records. A recurring weekly schedule or opening hours is not an occurrence; never expand recurrence.
- Verify that a single visit is allowed for one person, the exact regular single-person price, and any eligibility conditions, class-booking requirements, rentals, or other extras. A gym day pass does not imply group-class admission.
- Keep unknown prices, class inclusion, audience rules, language, dates, and availability unknown. Keep women-only, intro-only, member-only, or other conditions explicit.
- Do not create accounts, book, pay, contact organizers, enter gated flows, or bypass access controls.
- Apply the current profile settings when selecting offerings.
